title: Taxonomy Stress-Test: Generating Novel Jailbreaks Not in Existing Benchmark Categories

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: stress-testing taxonomy completeness is useful for governance. However, a small student team's creative output may not be comprehensive enough to draw strong conclusions about taxonomy gaps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Human creativity exercise plus running prompts through models and scoring with StrongReject. No technical complexity beyond basic inference. Very accessible for CS students. The challenge is creativity rather than implementation.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined: craft jailbreaks outside taxonomy, test on 2-3 models, score, categorize. Clear deliverable (list of out-of-taxonomy successful attacks). Fits in 30 hours as a structured red-teaming exercise.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
